description: Extract key information from Schedule K-1 (Form 1065) with focus on K2, K3 checkbox fields in Part II and Box 20 (Section 199A) information

FormType.description: The form type identifier. Located at the top of page 1, showing 'Schedule K-1 (Form 1065)'. Expected value: 'Schedule K-1 (Form 1065)'

TaxYear.description: The tax year for which this K-1 is filed. Found in the top section of the form. Format: 4-digit year. Example: '2023'

FormStatus.description: Whether this is a 'Final K-1' or 'Amended K-1'. Located near the year in the header. Look for checkboxes indicating status.

PartnershipEIN.description: Partnership's employer identification number found in Part I, field A. Format: XX-XXXXXXX. Example: '82-9875874'

PartnershipName.description: The legal name of the partnership. Found in Part I, field B. Example: 'Windy Place Properties, LLC'

PartnerName.description: The name of the partner receiving this K-1. Found in Part I, field F, below the 'For partner entered in E' label.

PartnerSSN.description: Partner's Social Security Number in Part II, field E. Format: XXX-XX-XXXX. Example: '987-65-4321'

PartnerType.description: Classification of partner in Part II, box G. Extract 'General partner or LLC member-manager' or 'Limited partner or other LLC member'. Identify which box is checked.

PartnerDomesticForeign.description: Whether partner is domestic or foreign, found in Part II, box H1. Extract 'Domestic partner' or 'Foreign partner' based on checked box.

PartnerEntityType.description: Type of entity for this partner in Part II, field I1. Examples: 'Individual', 'Corporation', 'Partnership', 'Trust', 'Estate'

ProfitShareBeginning.description: Partner's percentage share of profit at beginning of tax year in Part II, section J. Format with percentage. Example: '50.0000000%'

ProfitShareEnding.description: Partner's percentage share of profit at end of tax year in Part II, section J. Format with percentage. Example: '50.0000000%'

LossShareBeginning.description: Partner's percentage share of loss at beginning of tax year in Part II, section J. Format with percentage.

LossShareEnding.description: Partner's percentage share of loss at end of tax year in Part II, section J. Format with percentage.

CapitalShareBeginning.description: Partner's percentage share of capital at beginning of tax year in Part II, section J. Format with percentage.

CapitalShareEnding.description: Partner's percentage share of capital at end of tax year in Part II, section J. Format with percentage.

LiabilitiesNonrecourseBeginning.description: Nonrecourse liabilities at beginning of year in Part II, box K1. Format: currency. Example: '$100,000'

LiabilitiesNonrecourseEnding.description: Nonrecourse liabilities at end of year in Part II, box K1. Format: currency.

LiabilitiesQualifiedNonrecourseBeginning.description: Qualified nonrecourse financing at beginning of year in Part II, box K1. Format: currency.

LiabilitiesQualifiedNonrecourseEnding.description: Qualified nonrecourse financing at end of year in Part II, box K1. Format: currency.

LiabilitiesRecourseBeginning.description: Recourse liabilities at beginning of year in Part II, box K1. Format: currency. Example: '$263,050'

LiabilitiesRecourseEnding.description: Recourse liabilities at end of year in Part II, box K1. Format: currency. Example: '$263,050'

K2_LowerTierPartnershipLiabilities.description: Box K2 in Part II: Checkbox indicating if Item K-1 includes liability amounts from lower-tier partnerships. Check if this box is marked/checked. Located below the K1 liabilities section. Expected values: true (checked) or false (unchecked)

K3_LiabilityGuarantees.description: Box K3 in Part II: Checkbox indicating if any of the above liability is subject to guarantees or other payment obligations by the partner. Located below K2. Check if this box is marked/checked. Expected values: true (checked) or false (unchecked)

CapitalAccountBeginning.description: Beginning capital account in Part II, section L. Format: currency with sign (+ or -). Example: '$ -34,312' or '$ 34,312'

CapitalAccountEnding.description: Ending capital account in Part II, section L. Format: currency with sign. Example: '$ -40,637'

M_BuiltInGainProperty.description: Box M in Part II: Whether partner contributed property with built-in gain or loss. Extract 'Yes' or 'No' from the checkbox. Located below capital account section L.

OrdinaryBusinessIncome.description: Box 1 in Part III: Ordinary business income (loss). Format: currency with sign. Example: '0' or '-8,026'

NetRentalRealEstateIncome.description: Box 2 in Part III: Net rental real estate income (loss). Format: currency with sign. Example: '-8,026'

Box20Code.description: Box 20 'Other information' code identifier in Part III. Typically found as single letter code (like 'Z' for Section 199A information). Example: 'Z', 'STMT', 'X'

Box20Description.description: Box 20 description text. For code Z (Section 199A), this describes the nature of the information reported. May include references to 'Section 199A', 'Qualified Business Income', etc.

Box20Items.description: Items listed under Box 20. For Section 199A (code Z), these include line items with descriptions and amounts. Extract each item as a separate object with description and amount.

items.description: Individual Box 20 line item with description and amount

ItemDescription.description: Description of the Box 20 line item. Examples: 'Rental income (loss)', 'Unadjusted basis of assets', 'Rent -', etc.

ItemAmount.description: Dollar amount for the Box 20 line item. Format: currency, may be negative. Examples: '-8,026', '209,183', '' (blank)

Schedule199AAttached.description: Box 16 in Part III: Indicates whether Schedule K-3 is attached. Look for checkbox marked 'Schedule K-3 is attached if checked'. Expected values: true (checked) or false (unchecked)
